column1: # ENTRY is the program's LMX result, a C int over its whole range (R170-2, refinement 1)
# S8.1: library instances -- two of library A and one of B, constructed in the owner's arena, called interleaved
# Slice 254 (design 4.5 B1): free names resolve through the chain of activation records, the nearest current binding
# first; a data field the activation does not use is no binding.
# Slice 255 (design 4.5 B2a): a free name is runtime-typed -- one callee reached from bindings of different types; a write
# through the name, a return, a typed local, a typed formal and a condition receive the value by the kernel's one admission;
# a mismatch is the implicit `convert` throw, caught by the caller.
# Slice 256 (design 4.5 B2b-1): the consumers of a runtime-typed value -- the prefix sign, the connectives with their
# short circuit, a C-door actual received into the prototype's parameter type, a machine index, a cast, a reference result.
# Slice 257 (design 4.5 B2b, P1-RET): a walked method's declared result receives every present runtime-typed value by the
# one admission -- a number where a pointer is declared and a pointer where an int is declared are the implicit `convert`,
# caught by the callee's own pad or by the caller; the typed null literal and the compatible bindings pass.
# Slice 258 (design 4.5 B2b-2a): the deref, the write through and the address of a free name are runtime-typed by the
# kernel's pointer-code algebra -- pointer bindings of two pointee types, a write through the free pointer, the address of a
# pointer binding (a pointer to pointer) and of a number binding, a native body among walked ones.
# Slice 259 (design 4.5 B2b-2b): the bitwise and shift operators over a free operand run through the kernel's one binary
# operation in both executors (the walker's codes BAND/BOR/BXOR/SHL/SHR; the walked body evaluates the same frames): the
# C99 promotions, a shift count of its own type, the implicit interpreter throw for a count outside [0, width) or an
# overflowing signed left shift, the implicit convert for two types, a sub's bare write, the typed walked path.
# Slice 260 (design 4.5 B2b-2c): a free value received by a place with a receiving model -- a modelled own (declaration) and
# a modelled formal -- is received as the graph reference and admitted against the model at run time in both executors: a
# graph with the fields (Shape as Point), a graph without them (the implicit implements), a number (the implicit convert), a
# free pointer to a graph reference dereferenced into a modelled own (the deref level of the pointer coverage).
# Slice 261 (design 4.5 B2b-2d; P1-PTR-COVERAGE, the address level): the address of a free name bound to a graph reference
# (the kernel's own pointer code: the pointee is read from the cell, never from the code) received by typed pointer places at
# depth two and three by the actual pointees in both executors; the admission of the deref'd graph at the modelled own stays;
# a number's address at a graph pointer place and a graph reference's address at a depth-three place are the implicit convert.
# Slice 263: actual numeric reception and the selected Structure call.
# Selected code and explicit data: current field map, reached graph admission, copied calls.
# Typed native bitwise/shift uses the shared pre-operation checks.
# Shared unary bitwise complement and named kind refusal.
# Actual source-cell identity and declared bindings through explicit data.
